newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Int'l says in acquisition talks.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Int'l says in acquisition talks.

text.p: Optical products distributor Shenzhen International Holdings Ltd said it was in acquisition talks, which if successful would be a notifiable transaction under the listing rule.
"Confidential preliminary discussions have been commencing relating to a possible acquisition by the company," the company said in a statement issued through the stock exchange.
"The agreement relating to the possible acquisition has not been finalised yet and thus no assurance can be given that it will proceed," it said.
The company gave no further details, and officials declined to comment.
Trading in Shenzhen International's shares, which was suspended at the direction of Hong Kong stock exchange in the morning at 11.40 am local time, resumed in the afternoon.
The shares, which rose HK$0.12 or 25 percent to HK$0.60 each prior to the suspension, stood at HK$0.57 in early afternoon trade.
